facts.fact: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen said on Wednesday 1 April 2026 that the government was running a procurement to establish a digital occurrence book, through which a crime could also be reported from home or at the scene; it is described as to be established, not in use.
As of 1 April 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary described the digital occurrence book as still in procurement; no station is said to be using one.
The Interior Cabinet Secretary said on 1 April 2026 that the government itself was undertaking the procurement of the digital occurrence book.
On 1 April 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary announced that procurement of a digital occurrence book was under way.

systems.tiers: Not stated; in procurement in April 2026
